summary: Watch your flight in 3D: real 3D aircraft models, a chase camera that follows your plane, and a live Status line.
releaseNotes: 3D chase view: a new 3D chase button in Map settings puts the camera behind your aircraft at its real altitude, looking along its track over satellite imagery and terrain.
3D aircraft models: your plane and traffic fly as 3D aircraft at their real altitude, heading and bank, with a line down to the ground.
Realistic models for A320s, A321s and widebodies; jumbos, regional jets, turboprops, business jets and light aircraft get their own shapes.
Airline colours: popular airlines such as Emirates, Lufthansa, British Airways, Delta, Ryanair, easyJet and KLM are painted in their colours (no logos) on the shapes drawn in code.
Your own A320 is drawn with a detailed model in the 3D views.
Status line: the live strip now says what the flight is doing, for example "Climbing through 12,300 ft · 2,950 NM to EGLL" or "Final approach into EGLL".
The 3D views show a daylight sky and haze at the horizon instead of black.
The aircraft symbol on the 3D map points along its heading when the map is rotated.
3D aircraft models are credited on the map and in SOURCES_AND_LICENSING.md (CC BY 4.0, Sketchfab).
